project.name: Whitwick Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 6 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 12 of 14 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Whitwick qualifies as a local detour through Whitwick Castle and Church of St John the Baptist. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Whitwick: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Whitwick offers Whitwick Castle, Church of St John the Baptist, Church of St Andrew within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Whitwick Castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Whitwick Castle and Church of St John the Baptist, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Church of St John the Baptist
